THE BEST LINE SOURCE FOUND. Master II Genie Industriel thesis, FORLOUL Charef and SERBOUK Nesrine, 'Restructuration du reseau de transport urbain de la ville de Tlemcen', Universite Abou Bekr Belkaid Tlemcen, defended 25 June 2018. Tableau 3.1 p.50 lists 13 'lignes independantes' (private) with ref, both termini, bus count and stop count, service 06h00-20h00. Tableau 3.2 p.50 lists 6 'lignes publiques' (Ligne 01-06) with termini and bus count, service 06h00-23h00. Authors state the data came from the Direction des Transports of the wilaya of Tlemcen. Stop sequences exist only as ArcGIS map figures, not as text, so no stop lists are recoverable. WARNING: Figures 3.18-3.29 present a PROPOSED restructured network also numbered 'ligne 01'..'ligne 10'; that numbering collides with Tableau 3.2 and must not be conflated with the real network.
licence_or_terms_seen: None stated. Open-access institutional repository (DSpace, Universite de Tlemcen). No explicit reuse licence on the file.

what_it_provides: DSpace REST bitstream URL. Byte-identical (md5 232070fe2dbf58be4076e1965e59c59a) to the /bitstream/112/12959/ path above; same thesis, not a second source.

L'Express DZ, 26 August 2026. 20 new 100-seat buses entered service, assigned to reinforce NINE urban transport lines of the 'Etablissement public de transport urbain et suburbain' of Tlemcen, serving El Koudia, Boudjlida and Oudjlida (Tlemcen commune), Bouhenak and AADL (Mansourah), Ouzidane (Chetouane). A second batch of 20+ buses is planned for Hennaya and Beni Mester. NO line numbers, NO termini pairs. Useful only as a 2026 scale check: the public network is now nine lines, versus six in 2018.

what_it_provides: La Voie d'Algerie, 26 November 2025. 32 buses distributed across mostly INTERURBAN wilaya lines (Tlemcen-Maghnia 5, Tlemcen-Chetouane / Tlemcen-Sebdou / Tlemcen-Ouled Mimoun 3 each, Tlemcen-Bensakrane / Tlemcen-Nedroma 2 each, Ghazaouet-Souahlia 2, Tlemcen-Ain Fettah 1, Tlemcen-Tindouf 4). The only urban item: 'ligne urbaine 44' in Tlemcen city reinforced with four buses, two from the public urban and suburban transport enterprise and two from the private sector. Corroborates that line 44 exists and is mixed public/private.
